texts: good. "Together" is read as one joint keeping by the moth group rather than a separate act per moth, "displaced" is handed down to each moth individually instead of being pinned on the group as a whole, and the lanterns are placed at the Hollows as a named location. The maintenance sense of "keep" is preserved too: the lanterns' productive state is recorded as continuing and as the result of the keeping, with each lantern individually productive.
